Fields.Name: Weapon Poise Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplies the poise rate (EquipParamWeapon Toughness Correct Rate) of the weapon named by the TAE event; the result is added to the armor part of a player's maximum poise for the window. Not used for enemies.

Fields.Name: Minimum Poise
Fields.Description: Floor applied at the start of the window: the maximum poise is raised to at least this value, and the current poise is raised to it if it is lower. 0 = no floor.

Fields.Name: Minimum Ignores Multipliers
Fields.Description: If enabled, Minimum Poise is taken against the base poise scale (100 for players, NpcParam Toughness for enemies) instead of the window's multiplied maximum. Enemies only get a poise floor from rows with this enabled.

Fields.Name: Stagger Override SpEffect
Fields.Description: Players only. While poise holds, the damage level of incoming hits is replaced through this SpEffect's Damage Level replacement fields (dmgLv_*). -1: chosen from current poise: SpEffect 6354 at 100 or more, 6353 at 70, 6352 at 50, 6351 at 30, else 6350.

Fields.Name: Armor Poise Multiplier
Fields.Description: Players only. Multiplies the sum of the worn armor's poise rates (EquipParamProtector Toughness Correct Rate, four slots) in the maximum poise for the window.
